gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed GBM, presumed on the basis of clinical and MRI criteria (intra-axial brain tumor with peripheral rim contrast enhancement).

candidate_evidence.quote: 5-ALA HCl, 20 mg/kg, is orally administered 4-6 hours before the surgery. Then after resection of tumor tissue is judged maximal, the intraoperative PDT procedure is initiated at 200 J/cm\^2.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The primary objective of this clinical trial is to determine the safety and tolerability of two doses of light in intraoperative PDT added to standard of care; temozolomide-based chemotherapy in male and female patients aged 18 to 75 with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

agents.agent_name_registered: 5-ALA HCl intraoperative Photodynamic Therapy (PDT) (Pentalafen®, 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride)

role_evidence.quote: A Dose-escalation Clinical Study of Intraoperative Photodynamic Therapy of Glioblastoma
related to the intraoperative PDT (i.e., 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride (5-ALA HCl) administration + brain cavity illumination)

agents.drug_class_hint: photosensitiser prodrug (protoporphyrin IX precursor) for photodynamic therapy with Heliance light device

role_evidence.quote: Planned to receive SOC (i.e., Stupp Protocol) treatment after surgery.
two doses of light in intraoperative PDT added to standard of care; temozolomide-based chemotherapy

coder_notes: 5-ALA given for intraoperative photodynamic therapy (light-dose escalation with Heliance device), so candidate with device_dependent true (C12), not a diagnostic use. Arms differ only in light dose. Temozolomide not a registered intervention but every patient is planned to receive the Stupp protocol after surgery, so listed as soc_backbone.
